summary: Enhance your HR skills with our Data Analytics training course. Learn to leverage data for better decision-making and improve workforce management.
lede: HR data analytics helps HR professionals turn workforce records into useful measures for decisions about hiring, retention, and workforce capacity. For people analytics specialists, HR business partners, and HR operations managers, the course builds practical skills in defining metrics, checking data quality, and analyzing turnover and recruitment. Learners also practise creating workforce dashboards and presenting evidence-based recommendations using Excel, Power BI, and the CRISP-DM process.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals who work with workforce information, recurring people reports, or talent decisions. It suits foundation to intermediate learners and supports both hands-on practitioners and managers who need to evaluate analytical work. Each role below connects directly to a human resources analytics responsibility.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of core HR processes such as recruitment, employee records, performance, learning, or workforce planning is recommended. No programming or advanced statistics is required. You should be comfortable using spreadsheets and bring a laptop if the delivery format supports hands-on digital exercises. Advanced AI and predictive analytics are covered at conceptual and operational application levels, not technical engineering level.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
